proof_body:
by
  intro α _ s
  obtain ⟨i, hi, h1, h2⟩ := s.exists_compl_positive_negative
  refine ⟨i, hi, fun A hA hsub => ?_, fun A hA hsub => ?_⟩
  · simpa using (MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure.restrict_le_restrict_iff 0 s hi).1 h1 hA hsub
  · simpa using (MeasureTheory.VectorMeasure.restrict_le_restrict_iff s 0 hi.compl).1 h2 hA hsub
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [MeasurableSpace α] (s : MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure α), ∃ i : Set α, MeasurableSet i ∧ (∀ A, MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ i → 0 ≤ s A) ∧ (∀ A, MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ iᶜ → s A ≤ 0)
